pages.text: A Nurturing Crystal is grown, not crafted in one step: $(thing)Spirit Crystal Block → inactive bedrock → awakened bedrock → four growth stages → Nurturing Crystal$(). Heavy Cores, reinforcement plugins and advanced equipment all branch from this chain.

pages.heading: Set the Inactive Bedrock
pages.body: Vanilla and blast furnaces do not accept a Spirit Crystal Block.

pages.heading: Awaken the Bedrock
pages.body: Place both materials in a formed compressor. Blocked output consumes neither. Crafting-table activation is removed.

pages.title: Nurturing Crystal Bedrock
pages.text: It grows buds by random tick in any dimension. Personal-realm time scaling accelerates those ticks. The block also joins the common budding-block tag for compatible crystal-growth devices.

pages.title: Four Growth Stages
pages.text: A bud grows from small through medium and large into a mature cluster. The first three stages only continue growing; only the cluster yields the material.

pages.title: Harvesting the Crystal
pages.text: A mature cluster requires a netherite-tier tool. It drops one Nurturing Crystal by default and responds to Fortune; Silk Touch does not bypass maturity.

pages.title: Premixed Heavy Compound
pages.text: Combine a Nurturing Crystal, Netherite Block and Spirit Core shapelessly to prepare a sinterable Heavy Core blank.

pages.heading: Sinter a Heavy Core
pages.body: This is the compound's only forming process.

pages.heading: Budding Amethyst
pages.body: Decompress an amethyst block into 4 shards. Quartz blocks, chiseled/pillar/bricks/smooth variants and stairs return 4 quartz; slabs return 2. Stairs follow the stonecutter ratio to avoid duplication.
